intent: Choose files Button in a dashed drop zone (or a compact Button-only row) plus a list of file rows with progress, done, and error states. Presentational: the app does the upload; FileUpload reports picked files and renders the state it is given.
useWhen: Attaching files to a form, message, or record
Showing per-file upload progress, completion, and failures with retry
Inside Field when the upload needs a label, hint, or error
doNotUseWhen: A single overall task percent with no file rows — use Progress
Choosing an avatar or image crop — not this component
Picking a value from a list — use Select
Uploading on the network — FileUpload has no fetch; the app owns the request

onFilesSelected.note: (files: File[]) => void. Called after a pick or a drop. Dropped files are filtered by accept; multiple=false keeps the first.

variant.note: zone is the dashed drop area with a neutral sm Choose files Button, 'or drag and drop' and the limits line. compact is the Button and the limits line on one row, for drawers and tight forms. Both accept dropped files.

files.note: { id, name, size (bytes), progress? (0 to 100), status: 'uploading' | 'done' | 'error', error? }[]. Rows render in this order.

onRemove.note: (id) => void. When set, every row shows a remove Button (X while uploading, Trash2 after).

onRetry.note: (id) => void. When set, error rows show a labelled sm Retry Button.

accept.note: Same as the input accept attribute: extensions (.pdf) and MIME types (image/*).

maxSizeLabel.note: Limits line beside or under the Choose files Button, e.g. 'PDF or PNG, max 10 MB, up to 5 files'. Show it up front. Text only; the app enforces limits and reports them as row errors.

id.note: Choose files Button id. Inside Field, pass the same value as htmlFor.

describedBy.note: Set by Field (hint or error id).

error.note: Set by Field when it has an error. Danger border on the zone, like Input. Field's error text carries the message.

requirements: The focusable control is the kit Choose files Button, in both variants. It opens the hidden file input; Enter and Space work. Drag and drop is an enhancement, not the only path.
The limits line (maxSizeLabel) is linked to the Button with aria-describedby, plus Field's hint or error id
While files are dragged over, the zone reads 'Drop files here' in text and a brand border, not the border alone
error shows the danger border and Field's error text via aria-describedby; no aria-invalid on the trigger button (button does not support it)
The file input is hidden and out of the tab order
In the zone variant, keyboard focus on the Choose files Button draws one focus ring (--focus-ring at --border-focus-width) around the whole zone, and the Button's own ring is hidden
Each row's status text (Uploading, Complete, or the error) sits in aria-live=polite; the percent does not, so ticks are not announced
Uploading rows use Progress with ariaLabel 'Uploading {name}'
Remove Button has aria-label 'Remove {name}'; the Retry Button shows the word Retry (labels.retry) and is named 'Retry {name}' with aria-labelledby on its own id plus the file name
Status is never color alone: icon plus text
built-in labels (files, uploading, retry, removeFile) come from KitLabelsProvider; English by default
Error rows lead with an alert icon and show the size and message in text

doNot: Do not invent Dropzone, FileInput, FileList, FileRow, UploadItem, or UploadProgress
Do not fetch or upload inside the component — the app owns the request and passes files back
Do not use a native progress element — rows compose kit Progress
Do not show a raw input type=file as the control
Do not rely on color alone for done or error
Do not make the zone itself a button or put a link-styled 'Click to upload' in it — the action is the kit Choose files Button
snippet:
<Field label="Attachments" htmlFor="attachments">
  <FileUpload
    id="attachments"
    accept=".pdf,image/png"
    maxSizeLabel="PDF or PNG, max 10 MB, up to 5 files"
    files={files}
    onFilesSelected={startUploads}
    onRemove={removeFile}
    onRetry={retryFile}
  />
</Field>
